በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
ከማሁ: ከማሁ — likewise, like him (ከመ + -hu) · 'thus, so' answering ከመ (ከማሁ ታንጐደጒድ 'so it thunders')
ወረሰየ: ረሰየ — and he made, set (ወ- + 3ms perfect, r-s-y)
ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ለዝንቱ: ዝንቱ — to this one (ለ- + m. demonstrative) · ለ- marking the object, repeating the suffix on the verb (ለዝንቱ ወሬዛ, ለዝንቱ ሕፃን 'this lad, this child')
ቤት: ቤት — house (noun) · construct 'house of' (ቤት ስብሐቲከ 'house of your glory'; ሰብአ ቤት 'men of the house')
እምሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — from the people, tribe of (እም- + noun, construct)
አፍቅሮ: አፍቀረ — love him! (2ms imperative አፍቅር + -o '3ms him'; ለጠቢብ names the one)
አልቦሙ: አልቦ — they have not, there is not for them (negative existential + -ሙ '3mp them')
ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh'
ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
በሥጋሁ: ሥጋ — in his body, flesh (በ- + noun + -hu)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ለሰሎሞን: ሰሎሞን — Solomon (proper name; ለ- naming the possessor 'Solomon's') · ሰሎሞን — marking the object of ትፈቅድ አስጥሞቶ (ይእቲ ብእሲት ለሰሎሞን ንጉሥ 'that woman, [she wishes to drown] Solomon the king')
ዐውዳ: ዐውድ — around her (noun 'circuit' + -ሃ 'her', used as preposition)
ያነብር: አነበረ — that he set, place (3ms jussive, causative of ነበረ)
አርእስተ: ርእስ — heads, tops (plural አርእስት; construct 'heads of')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ዘተብህለ: ተብህለ — which was said (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect passive of ብህለ)
ይቤለኒ: ብህለ — he said to me (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ለኒ 'to me')
ሀቦ: ወሀበ — give him! (2ms imperative, w-h-b, + -ኦ '3ms him')
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king')
ለወልደ: ወልድ — the son of (ለ- marking the object + noun, construct)
ዐረብ: ዐረብ — Arabs, Arabia (noun; the dependent noun after the construct ብሔረ)
በእንቲአሁ: በእንተ — for his sake (በእንተ + -hu, variant በእንቲአሁ)
ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
ቡሩክ: ቡሩክ — blessed (adjective, passive participle of ባረከ)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world')
እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
ሀሎ: ሀሎ — be, exist (3ms perfect, present sense 'is')
ወኢይኔስሕ: ነስሐ — and he will not repent (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect ይኔስሕ, G)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 'let them say, let them call' (3mp jussive, ሎሙሰ ይብሉ አማልክቲሆሙ 'as for them, let them call them their gods')
ልብ: ልብ — heart (noun; here the genitive in ሐዘነ ልብ 'sorrow of heart')
ዘተናገረ: ተናገረ — which spoke, that speaks (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, reciprocal ተ- stem of ነገረ)
አእመሩ: አእመረ — they knew (3mpl perfect, a-stem, ʿ-m-r)
መጽሐፈ: መጽሐፍ — a book (noun, accusative) · construct 'book of' (መጽሐፈ ሕግ 'the book of the law', ch. 55)
ለጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — justice, righteousness (ለ- + noun; naming what suffix -ā pointed to)
ወሰሎሞንሰ: ሰሎሞን — and Solomon, indeed (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
ወለሊሁኒ: ለሊሁ — and he himself also (ወ- + ለሊ 'self' + -ሁ '3ms' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ወበጥበብ: ጥበብ — and in wisdom (ወ- + በ- + noun)
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
